items.name: Open-world city built from the plan: districts, streets, waterfront, crafted buildings
Tokyo Bay race circuit: harbor, suspension bridge over the bay, tunnel leg
Heading-based arcade driving with real collision (the car goes where its nose points)
3-lap circuit races against the clock and traffic, with nitro pickups and 5 hearts
Two-way traffic that streams in at a distance (no pop-in) and collides properly
Phone touch controls: screen-half steering, nitro button, pedal-shaped gas and brake pads
Menus and HUD in English: speed, lap and gig info, pause
Pedestrians walking the streets and obeying crossing signals
Timed delivery gigs in the open-world city (the core gig loop)
Money economy: gigs pay yen; cargo and car damage affect the payout
Garage upgrades bought with gig money; fittings unlock new cargo capabilities
City services: fuel stations, repair shops, tow recovery when stranded
Police and wanted system: crimes raise the wanted level, cops pursue and arrest
items.notes: Core system merged; defect tail still open (cop collision td-195, cop spawn placement td-274, wanted HUD evidence td-245).

When the dispatch queue is empty and no worker is live, the watchdog takes the first not_started item here, breaks it into tasks, and dispatches — game dev never idles while vision work remains.
